@patch(target="os.getcwd", new=np.array([-5.5, 3.0]))
def test_array_new():
    import os
    assert isinstance(os.getcwd, np.ndarray)
    assert (os.getcwd == np.array([-5.5, 3.0])).all()


@patch(target="os.getcwd")
def test_default_new(mock_getcwd):

@patch(target="os.getcwd", new=[1, 2, 3])
def test_list_new():
    import os
    assert os.getcwd == [1, 2, 3]

=== changelog ===
Fix ``ValueError`` when collecting tests which use ``unittest.mock.patch`` with an ``new`` argument whose value does not support a truth value (such as a numpy array), by comparing
the patching ``new`` value against the mock sentinels using identity instead of equality.
